verifications.claim: Artemis II is scheduled to launch on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II begins its journey to the moon | CNN (https://www.cnn.com/2026/04/01/science/live-news/artemis-2-nasa-launch)'; R2: 'Artemis 2 LIVE: NASA Orion capsule unfurls solar wings... Wednesday, April 1, 2026'; R3: 'NASA launched the Artemis II into space on Wednesday... at 6:35 p.m. ET'; R4: 'lifted off... on Wednesday, April 1'
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm the launch occurred on April 1, 2026, matching the scheduled date.

verifications.claim: Artemis II launch window opens at 6:24 p.m. EDT (22:24 GMT).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2 cited snippet: 'What time is NASA's Artemis II launch today?... The launch window opens today'; R3: 'lifted off... at 6:35 p.m. ET'; R4: 'The launch window opened on Wednesday, April 1, at 6:24 pm Eastern Time (EDT)'
verifications.reasoning: R4 directly states the window opens at 6:24 p.m. EDT; others confirm launch shortly after in that window.

verifications.claim: Artemis II launches from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'SLS rocket that fired the Artemis II crew to orbit'; R2: 'NASA's Kennedy Space Center'; R3: 'pad B at Kennedy Space Center in Cape Canaveral, Fla.'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant references explicitly state launch from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day crewed mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'living... in it alongside three other people for 10 days'; R2: '10-day journey'; R3: '10-day journey'; R4: 'the mission will last approximately 10 days'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly state the mission duration as 10 days and confirm it is crewed.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first mission to the moon since 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first time astronauts return to the vicinity of the moon in more than 50 years'; R2: 'first people to do so since the Apollo 17 crew in December 1972'; R3: 'first U.S. human lunar spaceflight in over 50 years'; R4: '53 years after Apollo 17'
verifications.reasoning: All confirm it is the first crewed mission to the moon vicinity since Apollo 17 in 1972.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will send four astronauts around the Moon and back.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Four astronauts on the Artemis II mission are on their way to journey around the moon'; R2: 'four Artemis 2 astronauts'; R3: 'four-member crew around the moon'; R4: 'four members of the Artemis II spacecraft aboard... circle it, and begin the return journey'
verifications.reasoning: All references state four astronauts fly around the moon and return.

verifications.claim: Artemis II has a potential launch window extending through April 6, 2026.

verifications.evidence: R2 cited snippet: 'What time is NASA's Artemis II launch today?... opportunities through Monday, April 6'
verifications.reasoning: Cited snippet directly mentions opportunities through April 6; high confidence as it matches pre-launch planning.
